_doc: What the watcher-creator skill teaches, one entry per teaching unit. anchor is a verbatim substring under heading in file (SKILL.md of cmd/agent-deck/assets/skills/watcher-creator); check.py static fails when it goes missing. checked_by names deterministic checkers (cli-drift); task evals list the promises they check in their own promises field.

promises.heading: Overview
promises.anchor: routes them to the appropriate conductor session
promises.summary: A watcher listens for events and routes them to a conductor session.

promises.heading: Step 1: Choose adapter type
promises.anchor: Present the five options:
promises.summary: Offer the five adapter types: webhook, ntfy, github, slack (Cloudflare Worker to ntfy), gmail (Pub/Sub).

promises.heading: Step 2: Gather required settings for the chosen type
promises.anchor: Ask for each required setting one at a time
promises.summary: Ask required settings one at a time.

promises.heading: Step 2: Gather required settings for the chosen type
promises.anchor: This becomes the directory name under the effective watcher data dir
promises.summary: The watcher name is the directory name under the watcher data dir.

promises.heading: Step 2: Gather required settings for the chosen type
promises.anchor: legacy `~/.agent-deck/watcher` remains in use when existing watcher state is present
promises.summary: Watcher data dir is $XDG_DATA_HOME/agent-deck/watcher, or legacy ~/.agent-deck/watcher when that state exists.

promises.heading: Step 2: Gather required settings for the chosen type
promises.anchor: the name `agent-deck conductor list` shows, not a session title
promises.summary: The conductor field is the conductor name from conductor list, not a session title.

promises.heading: Step 2: Gather required settings for the chosen type
promises.anchor: Which group the conductor session lives in (the `group` field in `clients.json`)
promises.summary: Ask for the group (clients.json group field).

promises.heading: Step 3: Emit the exact agent-deck watcher create command
promises.anchor: Only emit commands — do not execute them.
promises.summary: Emit the create command, never execute it.

promises.heading: Step 3: Emit the exact agent-deck watcher create command
promises.anchor: Run `create` before anyone writes a `watcher.toml` by hand
promises.summary: create writes watcher.toml itself and refuses a name whose watcher.toml exists, so it runs first.

promises.heading: Step 3: Emit the exact agent-deck watcher create command
promises.anchor: to change an existing watcher, edit its `watcher.toml` instead of re-running create
promises.summary: create fails for a registered name; edit watcher.toml to change a watcher.

promises.heading: Step 4: Optional settings go under [source] in that watcher.toml
promises.anchor: The engine reads a watcher's adapter settings only from the `[source]` table
promises.summary: Adapter settings live only under [source] in watcher.toml.

promises.heading: Step 4: Optional settings go under [source] in that watcher.toml
promises.anchor: All values are TOML strings, ports too.
promises.summary: watcher.toml values are TOML strings, ports included.

promises.heading: Step 4: Optional settings go under [source] in that watcher.toml
promises.anchor: Routing is not read from this file
promises.summary: Routing comes only from clients.json, never from watcher.toml.

promises.heading: Step 4: Optional settings go under [source] in that watcher.toml
promises.anchor: A file that does not parse stops the watcher from starting; after editing it, run `agent-deck watcher reload`
promises.summary: A broken watcher.toml stops the watcher; reload after editing.

promises.heading: Step 5: Generate a clients.json entry
promises.anchor: The key format depends on adapter type:
promises.summary: clients.json key format per adapter type.

promises.heading: Step 5: Generate a clients.json entry
promises.anchor: an exact key wins over a wildcard, and keys match case-insensitively
promises.summary: *@domain wildcard keys; exact wins; case-insensitive.

promises.heading: Step 5: Generate a clients.json entry
promises.anchor: "name": "Human-readable label"
promises.summary: clients.json entry has conductor, group and name.

promises.heading: Step 6: Start the watcher
promises.anchor: `watcher start` only marks the watcher running
promises.summary: start only marks it running; a TUI or web process runs the engine; reload applies now.

promises.heading: Step 6: Start the watcher
promises.anchor: `agent-deck watcher list` shows health and events per hour
promises.summary: watcher list shows health and events/hour.

promises.heading: Step 6: Start the watcher
promises.anchor: from the fixed sender `test@synthetic.local`
promises.summary: watcher test uses the fixed sender test@synthetic.local, not the user's key.

promises.heading: Step 6: Start the watcher
promises.anchor: `agent-deck watcher routes` lists the loaded rules
promises.summary: watcher routes lists the loaded routing rules.

promises.heading: Notes
promises.anchor: it does NOT execute `agent-deck watcher create` itself
promises.summary: The skill is read-only: it never runs create itself.

promises.heading: Notes
promises.anchor: Unknown senders are sent to triage.
promises.summary: Events are matched by sender against clients.json; unknown senders go to triage.

promises.heading: Notes
promises.anchor: agent-deck watcher install-skill watcher-creator
promises.summary: Install the skill into the pool with watcher install-skill.

promises.heading: Example walkthrough
promises.anchor: Run this first; it writes `github-myrepo/watcher.toml`
promises.summary: Worked example: create first, then clients.json, then start.

promises.heading: Example walkthrough
promises.anchor: Configure GitHub to send webhooks to `http://<your-server>:18461/github`.
promises.summary: GitHub posts to http://<server>:18461/github.

promises.heading: webhook
promises.anchor: accepts POST requests on `/webhook`
promises.summary: Webhook adapter serves POST /webhook.

promises.heading: webhook
promises.anchor: `watcher create webhook` requires `--port`
promises.summary: create webhook requires --port.

promises.heading: webhook
promises.anchor: the adapter falls back to `"18460"` only when a `watcher.toml` has no port
promises.summary: 18460 is only the adapter's fallback.

promises.heading: webhook
promises.anchor: or takes it from `$WEBHOOK_SECRET` or `--secret-file <path>` (chmod 600). Never put it on the command line.
promises.summary: Webhook secret: generated, $WEBHOOK_SECRET or --secret-file; never inline.

promises.heading: webhook
promises.anchor: The secret must be at least 16 bytes.
promises.summary: Webhook secret >= 16 bytes.

promises.heading: webhook
promises.anchor: `X-Webhook-Signature-256: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of timestamp + "\n" + X-Webhook-Sender + "\n" + raw body>`
promises.summary: Signature: HMAC-SHA256 of timestamp, sender, body joined by newlines.

promises.heading: webhook
promises.anchor: (within 5 minutes of the watcher's clock)
promises.summary: X-Webhook-Timestamp within 5 minutes or 401.

promises.heading: webhook
promises.anchor: each signature is accepted once and a replay gets 409
promises.summary: Replayed signature gets 409.

promises.heading: webhook
promises.anchor: On a loopback bind only, `X-Webhook-Token: <secret>` is accepted instead
promises.summary: X-Webhook-Token only on a loopback bind; 401 elsewhere.

promises.heading: webhook
promises.anchor: Requests with an `Origin` header get 403.
promises.summary: Origin header gets 403.

promises.heading: webhook
promises.anchor: `--no-secret` creates a watcher that accepts unsigned requests from local processes (not recommended)
promises.summary: --no-secret: unsigned local requests, not recommended.

promises.heading: webhook
promises.anchor: Default is `"127.0.0.1"` (loopback only).
promises.summary: Webhook bind defaults to 127.0.0.1.

promises.heading: webhook
promises.anchor: On a loopback bind with no secret, requests must address it as `localhost`, `127.0.0.1` or `[::1]`
promises.summary: Unsigned loopback watcher refuses other Host names.

promises.heading: webhook
promises.anchor: A non-loopback bind such as `"0.0.0.0"` only starts with a secret.
promises.summary: A non-loopback bind needs a secret.

promises.heading: webhook
promises.anchor: Without it the sender is the connection's remote address (`ip:port`, a new port per connection)
promises.summary: Set X-Webhook-Sender; the fallback ip:port matches nothing reliably.

promises.heading: webhook
promises.anchor: The header is only trusted when the signature covers it
promises.summary: X-Webhook-Sender is trusted only when signed, token, or unsigned local.

promises.heading: webhook
promises.anchor: never passing it as a command argument (other local users can read process arguments)
promises.summary: Sign with the secret read from watcher.toml, never as a command argument.

promises.heading: ntfy
promises.anchor: It auto-reconnects with exponential backoff.
promises.summary: ntfy adapter streams NDJSON and reconnects with backoff.

promises.heading: ntfy
promises.anchor: or `--random-topic` to generate a hard-to-guess one (not both)
promises.summary: --topic or --random-topic, not both.

promises.heading: ntfy
promises.anchor: ntfy server URL (`--server`). Default is `"https://ntfy.sh"`.
promises.summary: ntfy server defaults to https://ntfy.sh.

promises.heading: ntfy
promises.anchor: from `$NTFY_TOKEN` or `--token-file <path>` (chmod 600), never a CLI argument
promises.summary: ntfy token from $NTFY_TOKEN or --token-file.

promises.heading: ntfy
promises.anchor: anyone who knows a topic can read it and post fake events to it
promises.summary: Public ntfy.sh topics are readable/postable by anyone who knows them.

promises.heading: ntfy
promises.anchor: Create warns about a guessable topic on ntfy.sh without a token.
promises.summary: create warns about a guessable ntfy.sh topic without a token.

promises.heading: ntfy
promises.anchor: `ntfy:<topic>@<server-host>` (e.g., `ntfy:my-alerts@ntfy.sh`)
promises.summary: ntfy sender key ntfy:<topic>@<host>.

promises.heading: ntfy
promises.anchor: agent-deck watcher create ntfy --name <name> --random-topic
promises.summary: ntfy create command.

promises.heading: github
promises.anchor: receives GitHub webhook POST requests on `/github`
promises.summary: GitHub adapter serves POST /github with HMAC verification.

promises.heading: github
promises.anchor: It comes from `$GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET` or `--secret-file <path>` (chmod 600); an inline `--secret` is refused.
promises.summary: GitHub secret from env or --secret-file; inline refused.

promises.heading: github
promises.anchor: TCP port to listen on (`--port`). Default is `"18461"`.
promises.summary: GitHub port defaults to 18461.

promises.heading: github
promises.anchor: set up a tunnel (e.g., ngrok)
promises.summary: Public bind or a tunnel when GitHub must reach the machine.

promises.heading: github
promises.anchor: issues, pull_request, push. Unknown event types produce a generic event.
promises.summary: Supported GitHub events; unknown ones become generic events.

promises.heading: github
promises.anchor: or `*@github.com` for every sender.
promises.summary: GitHub sender key <login>@github.com or *@github.com.

promises.heading: github
promises.anchor: GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET=<secret> agent-deck watcher create github --name <name>
promises.summary: GitHub create command.

promises.heading: slack
promises.anchor: receives bridged Slack events from a Cloudflare Worker
promises.summary: Slack arrives via a Cloudflare Worker posting to ntfy.

promises.heading: slack
promises.anchor: It supports both v1 (plain text) and v2 (structured JSON) payloads.
promises.summary: v1 plain text and v2 JSON payloads.

promises.heading: slack
promises.anchor: `slack:<CHANNEL_ID>` (e.g., `slack:C0AABSF5GKD`)
promises.summary: Slack sender key slack:<CHANNEL_ID>.

promises.heading: slack
promises.anchor: The channel ID comes from the Slack API or the channel URL in the Slack app.
promises.summary: Where to find the channel ID.

promises.heading: slack
promises.anchor: A v1 (plain text) payload carries no channel and arrives as `slack:unknown`.
promises.summary: v1 payloads arrive as slack:unknown.

promises.heading: slack
promises.anchor: agent-deck watcher create slack --name <name> --topic <topic>
promises.summary: Slack create command.

promises.heading: gmail
promises.anchor: there is no create command to emit and no `watcher oauth` command
promises.summary: gmail cannot be created or run yet; no oauth command.

promises.heading: gmail
promises.anchor: Tell the user so instead of inventing one, and offer another route for the mail
promises.summary: Say so and offer another route, never invent a command.

promises.heading: gmail
promises.anchor: Full Pub/Sub subscription resource name: `projects/<project-id>/subscriptions/<sub-name>`
promises.summary: Gmail topic and subscription are full Pub/Sub resource names.

promises.heading: gmail
promises.anchor: Default: `<effective watcher data dir>/<name>/token.json`.
promises.summary: credentials.json and token.json default to the watcher dir.

promises.heading: gmail
promises.anchor: Comma-separated Gmail label filter (e.g., `"INBOX,UNREAD"`). If absent, all messages pass through.
promises.summary: labels filter; absent = all.

promises.heading: gmail
promises.anchor: Informational Gmail address for display purposes.
promises.summary: account is informational only.

promises.heading: gmail
promises.anchor: Grant the Gmail service account (`gmail-api-push@system.gserviceaccount.com`) the `Pub/Sub Publisher` role on the topic.
promises.summary: Grant gmail-api-push Pub/Sub Publisher on the topic.

promises.heading: gmail
promises.anchor: Download OAuth client credentials (Desktop app type) to `credentials.json`.
promises.summary: OAuth client credentials of Desktop app type.

promises.heading: gmail
promises.anchor: Place an OAuth `token.json` in the watcher directory (no agent-deck command creates it).
promises.summary: token.json is placed by hand; no command creates it.

promises.heading: gmail
promises.anchor: or `*@example.com` for a whole domain.
promises.summary: Gmail sender key is the email address or *@domain.

promises.heading: Validation checklist
promises.anchor: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.
promises.summary: Name: lowercase letters, digits, hyphens.

promises.heading: Validation checklist
promises.anchor: The name must not already be registered or have a `watcher.toml` (`agent-deck watcher list`).
promises.summary: Name must be fresh; check watcher list.

promises.heading: Validation checklist
promises.anchor: The chosen port is not already in use by another watcher or service.
promises.summary: Port must be free (webhook/github).

promises.heading: Validation checklist
promises.anchor: check with `agent-deck conductor list`
promises.summary: Check the conductor with conductor list.

promises.heading: Validation checklist
promises.anchor: its session titled `conductor-<name>`, which must not be archived
promises.summary: Delivery goes to the non-archived conductor-<name> session.

promises.heading: Validation checklist
promises.anchor: All required fields for the chosen adapter type are present and non-empty.
promises.summary: All required fields present and non-empty.

promises.heading: Validation checklist
promises.anchor: (e.g., `slack:CHANNEL_ID` not just `CHANNEL_ID`)
promises.summary: Sender key matches the adapter's normalization.
